business_model.basis: Stated directly in the 10-K Business section (P1).
business_model.claim: Resolute Holdings is an operating management company that earns recurring, long-duration quarterly management fees from the businesses it manages and does not own any equity in those businesses.
quotes: Resolute Holdings (together with GPGI Holdings and Husky Holdings, the "Company") only receives management fees from GPGI Holdings and Husky Holdings and does not own any equity interests including common stock in GPGI Holdings, Husky Holdings, or GPGI.

business_model.basis: Stated in both the 10-K (P1) and the 10-Q MD&A (P4).
business_model.claim: The management fee is a cash amount equal to 2.5% of the managed company's trailing 12-month Adjusted EBITDA, payable quarterly in arrears.
quotes: GPGI Holdings pays Resolute Holdings a quarterly management fee (the "CompoSecure Management Fee"), payable in arrears, in a cash amount equal to 2.5% of GPGI Holdings' last 12 months' Adjusted EBITDA, as defined in the CompoSecure Management Agreement, measured for the period ending on the fiscal quarter then ended.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Business section (P1) and repeated in the 10-Q MD&A (P4).
business_model.claim: As of mid-2026 the company manages two operating businesses: CompoSecure (premium metal payment cards and secure authentication solutions, headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey) and Husky (highly engineered injection molding equipment and aftermarket tooling, headquartered in Bolton, Ontario, Canada).
quotes: CompoSecure, founded in 2000, and headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey, is the global leader in the design and manufacturing of premium metal payment cards and secure authentication solutions.
Husky, founded in 1953, and headquartered in Bolton, Ontario, is the leading global manufacturer of highly engineered injection molding equipment and aftermarket tooling and services.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A (P3) and the 10-Q MD&A (P4); the 8-K release (P6) reiterates the caveat.
business_model.claim: Because Resolute Holdings is the primary beneficiary of GPGI Holdings under ASC 810, it consolidates the full financial results of GPGI Holdings and Husky Holdings, so the consolidated income statement reflects the managed businesses' product sales rather than management-fee revenue.

Net sales reflect the Company's revenue generated from the sale of products and services by GPGI Holdings' businesses, CompoSecure and Husky, as management fee revenue at Resolute Holdings is eliminated in consolidation.
